provenance.note: Copied once from the unsquashed Vertex research chain (1.6B, 1.7, 1.8 Phase F) so this study does not depend on the order of the squashes. Values unchanged; each block names its file and key path.

levers.label: Radiator capacity
levers.what: More radiator area per engine. Canon gives each engine 2.70 GW (75 % of the 14.4 GW radiator, four engines).

levers.label: Coil neutron shielding
levers.what: Shielding wrapped round each coil (1.6B). It protects the superconductor; it does not remove heat, it absorbs it.

levers.label: Plasma leaking onto hardware
levers.what: Charged exhaust that the magnetic nozzle fails to send aft (1.6B computed 18.3 %).

levers.label: Photon and neutron output
levers.what: A cleaner burn: less X-ray and neutron energy per joule of fusion. It also slows the neutron damage to the coils.

levers.label: Target gain
levers.what: How much fusion energy each joule of driver energy buys. The driver power comes back as heat.

levers.label: Power throttle
levers.what: Run the drive gentler. The burn gets longer in proportion (power-limited).

fails.what: the driver needs 1.432e+06 MW; the 50 MW pulse bank, the only budgeted source, is empty
7,804x more heat than the radiators carry: the engine is +1000 K
neutrons end the C2 superconductor, it quenches and releases its stored energy

scenarios.title: Overload
scenarios.subtitle: The energy has nowhere to go
scenarios.assumes: Heat removed perfectly (infinite radiators), so only the energy problems are left.

events.title: Ignition at the mission point
events.text: 71.6 TW of fusion per engine. The budget expects 80 % to leave as exhaust and 4e-5 to be absorbed.

events.title: The pulse bank is empty
events.text: The driver needs 1.43 TW per engine (28,630x the 50 MW bank). Nothing in the ship budget feeds it after the bank (1.7, 1.8 F: driver power was never budgeted).

events.title: Every pulse squeezes the coils
events.text: Each pulse compresses the coil flux up to 1.86x (1.3), beyond the coil rating: case stress beyond allowable (1.7 F-OVERLOAD).

events.title: C2 quenches
events.text: Neutrons end the nearest superconductor after 1.71 s (1.6B, unshielded). It turns resistive and dumps 9.7 GJ, about 2.3 t of TNT, into the cold mass (1.7 F-QUENCH).

events.title: The neighbours follow
events.text: One engine without field leaves unbalanced forces of about 14 MN on its neighbours (1.2); their coils quench in turn.

scenarios.title: Meltdown
scenarios.subtitle: The heat has nowhere to go
scenarios.assumes: Driver powered from somewhere and coils that never wear out, so only the heat is left.

events.title: Ignition at the mission point
events.text: 18.1 TW of heat reaches each engine; its radiators carry 2.70 GW.

events.title: The coils lose their cold
events.text: The 20 K circuit can lift 9 MW per engine (1.6B); the windings receive thousands of times more.

events.title: The armour faces reach their limit
events.text: About 1.2e9 W/m2 on the lit tiles: their limit in about 12 ms (1.7 F-TREAD).

events.title: The whole engine is 1000 K hotter
events.text: Heat capacity of 1,244 t for +1000 K is used up in 34 ms (1.5 T3). 6,720x more heat arrives than the radiators carry.

events.title: Parts soften and flow aft
events.text: Under the thrust the softened structure slumps aft along the axis; the lithium hydride shield goes first (961 K).
